dog.description_text:
Meet Tootles!

Tootles is a sweet and affectionate personality! This handsome guy loves being in good company and enjoys having his people nearby. He's always happy to share some love and make himself comfortable around his favorite humans.

Tootles is quite the little purr machine! He loves cheek scratches and will happily roll around while soaking up all the attention. His adorable ways of showing affection are sure to bring a smile to your face!

If you're looking for a loving companion who enjoys good company, plenty of cheek scratches, and lots if happy purrs, Tootles is ready to meet you!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
